upstream_calls.smc: diffres.feynman_kac.smc_feynman_kac(key, m0_sampler, log_g0, m_log_g, ys, nparticles, nsteps=T, resampling=<callable>, resampling_threshold, return_path=True) (https://github.com/zgbkdlm/diffres/blob/767effe3e755067eb8a04422597fbf37eb8ab754/diffres/feynman_kac.py lines 22-115), called unchanged

resamplers.diffusion: diffusion_resampling(k, lw, s, a, jnp.linspace(0, T, K+1), integrator, ode, jitter) (tests/test_filters.py test_diffres, experiments/lgssm/diffusion.py lines 59-60, demos/gradient_variance2.py jitter=1e-5)
resamplers.ensemble_ot: ensemble_ot(k, lw, s, eps, implicit_diff=...) (experiments/lgssm/ot.py; tests use implicit_diff default True)
resamplers.soft: soft_resampling(k, lw, s, alpha) (experiments/lgssm/soft.py); returns non-uniform normalised log weights, which smc_feynman_kac adds to the next potential (works with its (key, log_ws, samples) -> (log_ws, samples) signature unchanged)
resamplers.gumbel_softmax: gumbel_softmax(k, lw, s, tau) (experiments/lgssm/gumbel.py; upstream additionally jax.jit-wraps it, no semantic difference)

upstream_calls.gradient: jax.value_and_grad(run_smc, argnums=(F, H), has_aux=True) of the smc nll, as demos/gradient_variance2.py lines 82-89 (there w.r.t. scalar params); nll returned from the same call
upstream_calls.moments: PF weighted filtering means/covs via the einsums of experiments/lgssm/diffusion.py lines 118-120
upstream_calls.kalman_comparison: diffres.gaussian_filters.kf(ys, m0, P0, F, Q, H, R); per-step jax.vmap(diffres.tools.kl)(mfs_kf, vfs_kf, mfs_pf, vfs_pf) and bures likewise; means over all T+1 steps (experiments/lgssm/diffusion.py lines 116-122)

extracted_code.what: bootstrap m0_sampler, log_g0, m_log_g closures, bound to the user's matrices instead of module constants
generalisation_to_matrices: m0 sampler: m0 + normal(key,(N,dx)) @ chol(P0).T (identical to the test).

transition: samples @ F.T + normal(key,(N,dx)) @ chol(Q).T; the test uses the elementwise (trans_cov ** 0.5).T, which equals chol(Q) for diagonal Q (bitwise equal on the test model); Cholesky as in diffres.tools.simulate_lgssm.

observation potential: diagonal R -> sum of univariate jax.scipy.stats.norm.logpdf(y, x @ H.T, sqrt(diag R)) exactly as upstream; non-diagonal R -> jax.vmap of diffres.tools.logpdf_mvn_chol(y, H x, chol(R)) (the density used by gaussian_filters.kf). Same random-number order and shapes as upstream, so test/experiment keys reproduce.

parameters_and_defaults.observations_path: required; .npz 'ys' (T+1, dy); (T+1,) accepted when dy=1 and read as (T+1,1) (the test passes 1-D ys; per-step values identical)
parameters_and_defaults.diffusion_a/T/steps/integrator/ode: -0.5 / 3.0 / 8 / 'euler' / True = experiments/lgssm/diffusion.py CLI defaults; ts = linspace(0, T, steps+1) as every upstream caller; integrators euler, lord_and_rougemont, jentzen_and_kloeden, tweedie (ode=False only), diffrax (ode=True only) -- unsupported combinations rejected with a clear ValueError instead of upstream's trace-time NotImplementedError('Unknown integrator')
parameters_and_defaults.ot_eps: None -> upstream default 1/log(N) (reported as resolved eps); tests use 0.1, experiments/lgssm/ot.py default 1.0
parameters_and_defaults.ot_implicit_diff: False, as experiments/lgssm/ot.py (PF gradient use; upstream docstring warns implicit diff may be unstable, issue #5); forward values identical to True on the test model (smoke)
parameters_and_defaults.seed/prng_key: shared contract; key used returned as prng_key
parameters_and_defaults.save_particle_path: False; True adds samples_path (T+1,N,dx) and log_weights_path (T+1,N)

io_adaptations: smc_feynman_kac is always called with return_path=True (as tests/test_filters.py and the experiments' filtering-error code) so per-step filtering moments and ESS can be returned; save_particle_path only controls what is written. return_path=False would give the same nll up to ~1e-14 (executor lgssm_diffusion_experiment).

Single artifact particle_filter.npz: final-step 'samples' (N,dx) and normalised 'log_weights' (N,) -- same names as the resampling tools' particles_path contract so the output can be fed to them; ess, filtering_means, filtering_covs, nll, nll_plus_log_n, prng_key; optional path, grad_F/grad_H, kf_* and kl/bures per step.

Returned JSON: nll (raw upstream), nll_plus_log_n (= nll + log N, documented convenience; upstream omits +log N in the time-0 term, feynman_kac.py lines 82-85), ESS summary (final/min/mean, number of resampling steps = count of ess[k-1] < threshold*N for k=1..T, i.e. the upstream lax.cond predicate), final filtering mean, gradient Frobenius norms + finiteness + per-method gradient-semantics note, KF comparison (kf_nll, nll_plus_log_n - kf_nll, mean/max KL and Bures).
KL direction and scale documented, not changed: diffres.tools.kl(m_KF, P_KF, m_PF, P_PF) = 2 * KL(N_KF || N_PF) (no 1/2 factor upstream); bures = squared 2-Wasserstein distance.

Input checks: required JSON keys, shapes, finiteness, Q/R/P0 symmetric and positive definite (numpy Cholesky), m0 shape, ys shape/finiteness, nparticles>=1, threshold in [0,1], method-parameter ranges, prng_key format.
not_exposed: jaxopt L-BFGS optimisation and 128x128 loss grids of experiments/lgssm (benchmark-only; upstream L-BFGS did not move at reduced settings)
